name: Layout Builder Enhancements
description: Adds extra functionality to Layout Builder (blocks, views, visual helpers).
project_description:
This module add some enhancements for Drupal Core's Layout Builder.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 View Block : A view block with automatic offset calculation to place views items flexible into a Layout Builder Grid 
 Layout builder preview : Add a new view mode for blocks with a complex layout to show a preview in layout builder.
